g.text: One peer is expanded. Peer agreement and checkpoint exchanges run for all five peers.
Guard definitions and detailed-message coverage are in setup_development_contracts.md.
Exact schemas, cryptographic contexts, and failure classes are normative in ../../../spec/SPEC.md.
S-SAR-1 doxing_password, selected SarId, rescue data
Derive SAR-specific doxing key and lookup identifier.
Encrypt static data under the SAR root; dynamic bytes under device-derived keys.
S-SAR-3 payment info; SAR records doxing_data_identifier, PROTOCOL_VERSION, and invoice
S-SAR-6 payment receipts, doxing_data_identifier, static envelope, dynamic_update_auth_key, first_dynamic_doxing_data_upload
S-INSTALL-1 network, key path inputs, entropy, passphrase, doxing password, SarId
Derive mnemonic, normal key, and doxing key
Generate Boomlet identity key and MuSig2 share.
[S-CONSENT exactly two fresh nonce-bound enrollment rounds]
Enc_Boomlet(DuressResponse{five original indices, nonce}) via Iso
Store the first resolved set; require the second resolved set to equal it.
Setup instance review and peer agreement
S-PARAMS-5 trusted display of local record
S-PARAMS-6 exchange five signed PeerSetupRecords out of band
S-PARAMS-7 five records, ordered WT preferences, milestone blocks
Derive setup_instance_id from PROTOCOL_VERSION and the canonical seed.
S-REVIEW-1 setup_instance_id and Enc_ST(nonce-bound setup commitment)
S-REVIEW-2 commitment and canonical seed fields
S-REVIEW-3 ordered peers, WT preferences, milestones, protocol version
S-REVIEW-5 Enc_Boomlet(Sig_ST(exact nonce-bound commitment)) via Niso
S-AGREE-2 one matching signed fingerprint from every other peer via Niso
S-WT-1 setup_instance_id, signed PeerSetupRecord_i, signed params fingerprint via Niso
S-WT-2 corresponding registration from every other peer
Accept all five registrations under G-WT-REGISTRATION
S-WT-3 peer-specific payment info bound to setup_instance_id via Niso
S-WT-7 matching Sig_Boomlet_j(C_wt) from every other peer via Niso
Accept the local signature and four peer signatures under G-SETUP-CHECKPOINT.
S-SAR-ACT-1 signed selected SarId and Enc_SAR(setup_instance_id, identifier) via Niso
Accept binding under G-SAR-BINDING; select only the setup-bound SAR
S-SAR-ACT-2 encrypted identifier payload, Boomlet identity, setup_instance_id
S-SAR-ACT-4 Sig_WT(wrapper with exact SAR response) via Niso
Accept WT wrapper and local SAR response under G-SAR-SETUP-RESPONSE
S-SAR-ACT-6 matching Sig_Boomlet_j(C_sar) from every other peer via Niso
Accept the local signature and four peer signatures under G-SETUP-CHECKPOINT.
S-BACKUP-1 install empty Boomletwo and provide recovery inputs
S-BACKUP-5 target-encrypted backup state, boomerang_params, signed SAR response
Reconstruct descriptor; verify active identity, milestones, SAR response, and static-data commitment.
S-BACKUP-6 active identity and target-encrypted backup state
Require empty target; authenticate, decrypt, and import state with embedded setup_instance_id
Accept under G-BACKUP-DONE; mark backup complete
S-BACKUP-10 matching Sig_Boomlet_j(C_backup) from every other peer via Niso
Accept the local signature and four peer signatures under G-SETUP-CHECKPOINT.
SAR_READY -> BACKUP_READY; persist final checkpoint before success.
Any invalid identity, signature, envelope, nonce, setup binding, ordering, receipt, checkpoint,
or state transition stalls the attempt under the failure rules in SPEC section 18.
